In Wifi calling, the phone makes a VPN to the provider's gateway.
In case of Singtel & its MVNO, it is epdg.epc.mnc001.mcc525.pub.3gppnetwork.org
5G/4G or ios/Android should not matter as far as your wifi is concern (the gateway side can choose to reject)
So unless you have a firewall blocking the 5G phones, it should not be a problem on your side.
Starhub (& MVNO) uses a different gateway : epdg.epc.mnc005.mcc525.pub.3gppnetwork.org
Simba gateway : epdg.epc.mnc010.mcc525.pub.3gppnetwork.org
M1 (& Maxx) uses a non standard gateway : epdg.mobileone.net.sg

Changing your phone's 5G/4G connection setting will not make a difference in these cases since it is based on subscription.

Example: You want to divert your M1 number to a RedOne SG number.
1) Setup the call divert on your M1.

I think this is what happened in your case.
